site_name: four villages approximately 50 km north-west of Kisumu
temporal_notes: Collected in 1999; specific months not reported.
source_text: In 1999 a further forty-two An. gambiae s.l. were collected from the same villages. The diagnostic PCR described above identified three individuals that were heterozygous for the kdr mutation at the sodium-channel locus. All the remaining individuals were homozygous for the wild-type susceptible allele. The three heterozygotes were all identified as An. gambiae s.s. by species ID PCR (Paskewitz & Collins, 1990).

temporal_notes: Laboratory cross between Kenyan RSP-ST strain (colonized 1992) and FAST strain; cross date not specified.
source_text: Females from the RSP-ST strains were crossed with single males from the susceptible FAST strain and the F2 progeny from families 6 and 9 were scored for resistance to permethrin. The diagnostic PCR was used to confirm the homozygous state of the parents and to genotype the F2 progeny. All seventy-five progeny (twenty-seven survivors and forty-eight non-survivors) from family 9 were genotyped plus twenty-three of the thirty-four survivors and twenty-four of the sixty-one non-survivors from family 6.
